headline: Philip Morris (PM) Bets $1.2B on ZYN as BAT (BTI) Steps Up Its Pouch Push
summary: Philip Morris International (NYSE:PM) just turned a $600 million plan into a $1.2 billion one. On July 27, the company opened its Aurora, Colorado manufacturing campus, a 780,000-square-foot facility built to produce ZYN nicotine pouches.
